note: work_score is the episode mean of the accepted work over the work order (per pair: lacing of each shoe 0.30 + 0.30, box erected 0.12, and pair packed 0.13, lid closed 0.10, shipped 0.05 each times the fraction of the pair's shoes laced through every row; a safety violation voids the pair at work), already on [0, 1]; ratio = score / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1). Measured, not drawn: every submission meets the same 6 episodes (tests/hidden/seeds.json), and the reference repeated each selection run's score to the last bit in the verify (the same simulated time, ticks and per-pair detail in all 6). full_at 0.98 is the margin for a last-bit difference on another host flipping part of an episode: a submission earns reward 1.0 (two decimals) from work_score 0.9751; boxing every pair without lacing (0.12 per episode) reads reward 0.12, lacing one shoe per pair and boxing it (0.56) 0.57. One shoe lost in one episode by the reference itself (0.56 there, mean 0.927) would read 0.95: the set was chosen so that does not happen on this image (23 of 24 candidates at 1.0 from a physical start, the image equal to the host venv to the bit on 4 seeds of the first selection).
